title: Data Types and Variables
description: Understand Python's data types (int, float, str, bool, list, tuple, dict, set) and dynamic typing. Learn variable assignment, type hints, and immutability concepts.

title: Loops and Control Flow
description: Master for/while loops, if/elif/else statements, and match/case (Python 3.10+). Cover loop control (break, continue, else) and Pythonic iteration techniques.

title: Lists and Arrays
description: Manipulate lists (slicing, methods) and NumPy arrays. Compare lists vs. arrays for data processing.

title: Functions
description: Define functions (parameters, return values), use lambda expressions, and apply decorators (@ syntax) for metaprogramming.

title: Object-Oriented Programming
description: Implement classes, inheritance (single/multiple), polymorphism, and magic methods (__init__, __str__). Understand method resolution order (MRO).

title: Data Types and Variables
description: Learn C# type system (value/reference types), nullable types (int?), var keyword, and constants (const vs. readonly).

title: Control Structures
description: Master if/else, switch expressions (C# 8+), pattern matching, and loops (for, foreach, while, do-while).

title: Collections
description: Work with arrays, Lists<T>, Dictionaries, and LINQ queries (Where, Select, Aggregate). Compare IEnumerable vs. IQueryable.

title: OOP in C#
description: Implement classes, interfaces, abstract classes, inheritance, polymorphism, and C# specifics (properties, indexers, events).

title: Database Fundamentals
description: Understand tables, schemas, primary/foreign keys, and basic data types (INT, VARCHAR, DATETIME).

title: CRUD Operations
description: Write INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, and SELECT statements. Filter data with WHERE clauses.

title: Joins and Relationships
description: Master INNER/LEFT/RIGHT/FULL JOINs, self-joins, and relational database design principles.

title: Stored Procedures
description: Create and optimize stored procedures with parameters, error handling (TRY/CATCH), and transaction control.

title: Variables and Data Types
description: Learn `let`, `const`, `var`, primitive types (string, number, boolean), and dynamic typing. Understand `null` vs. `undefined`.

title: Functions and Scope
description: Declare functions (arrow vs. traditional), handle closures, and master scope (global, block, lexical).

title: DOM Manipulation
description: Select/modify HTML elements, handle events (click, submit), and dynamically update the DOM.

title: Async JS (Promises, Async/Await)
description: Manage asynchronous operations with callbacks, promises, and async/await. Handle APIs with `fetch`.

title: HTML Structure
description: Master document structure (`<!DOCTYPE>`, `<html>`, `<head>`, `<body>`), semantic tags (`<header>`, `<article>`), and metadata.

title: Forms and Inputs
description: Create forms (`<form>`, `<input>` types), validate inputs, and use accessibility attributes (`aria-*`).

title: Multimedia and Embedding

title: Selectors and Box Model
description: Use CSS selectors (class, ID, pseudo-classes) and understand margin/padding/border (box model).

title: Flexbox and Grid
description: Build layouts with Flexbox (alignment, wrapping) and CSS Grid (tracks, areas).

title: Responsive Design (Media Queries)
description: Implement mobile-first designs using media queries and relative units (rem, vw).

title: R Basics and Vectors
description: Learn R syntax, atomic vectors (numeric, character), and vectorized operations.

title: Data Frames and dplyr
description: Manipulate data frames with `dplyr` (filter, mutate, group_by). Import/export CSV/Excel files.

title: Statistical Modeling
description: Run linear/logistic regression, hypothesis tests (t-test, ANOVA), and interpret results.
